On his quest to solve a murder case , Raj goes to Darjeeling where he meets Roma ( Shabana Azmi ) and falls in love with her .
Suraj who is also in Darjeeling falls in love with Roma too , but hesitant to communicate .
Roma tells Raj of how her mother had been hooked to drugs by Devi Dayal .
A series of incidents reveal all the secrets and Raj and Suraj unite to take revenge for their father 's death .
